title: Oven Baked Egyptian Kippers Tagine
description: A flavorful and aromatic Egyptian dish featuring kippers, perfect for a weeknight dinner, this recipe combines the richness of kippers with the brightness of floral notes in a unique tagine style, all while being kosher-friendly and utilizing a wooden board for serving.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together olive oil, onion, garlic, ginger, cumin, coriander, cayenne pepper, salt, and black pepper.
Add the kippers to the bowl and marinate for at least 30 minutes, or up to 2 hours in the refrigerator.
Transfer the kippers and marinade to a wooden board lined with parchment paper.
Bake the kippers in the preheated oven for 12 minutes, or until cooked through.
While the kippers are baking, prepare the tagine sauce by whisking together lemon juice and 1 tablespoon of water.
After the kippers have baked for 10 minutes, brush the tagine sauce over the top of each kipper.
Return the kippers to the oven and bake for an additional 2 minutes, or until the sauce is caramelized.
Remove the kippers from the oven and let rest for 2 minutes before serving.
Serve the kippers hot, garnished with chopped fresh parsley or cilantro if desired.
